scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @record-platform/server" "npm run dev -w @record-platform/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @record-platform/core && npm run build -w @record-platform/server && npm run build -w @record-platform/web
scripts.check: npm run check -w @record-platform/core && npm run check -w @record-platform/server && npm run check -w @record-platform/web
